responseMessageContents.text: The user wants to know exactly what environment variables they need to add on Render. Let me give them a clear, concise list based on my audit findings.

Here's exactly what you need to set on the Render dashboard (Environment tab for your `ivx-holdings-platform` service):

## Required on Render

| Variable | Value | Why |
|----------|-------|-----|
| `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY` | Your Vercel AI Gateway API key (get it at https://vercel.com/~/ai-gateway/api-keys) | Enables AI/ChatGPT — IVX uses its own key, zero Rork dependency |
| `IVX_OWNER_PASSWORD` | Your owner login password | Fixes owner passwordless login (currently 503) |
| `SENDGRID_API_KEY` | Your SendGrid API key | Enables email (welcome emails, wire confirmations, etc.) |

## Supabase (separate dashboard)

| Action | Where | Why |
|--------|-------|-----|
| Unpause project `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb` | https://supabase.com/dashboard | Database is paused — all Supabase queries time out |

## Optional (if you use them)

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
| `FB_PIXEL_ID` | Your Facebook/Meta pixel ID |
| `GA_MEASUREMENT_ID` | Your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | Fix the broken APK download path (S3) |

## Already configured (no action needed)
- `SUPABASE_URL` ✓
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` ✓
- `IVX_SUPABASE_URL` ✓
- Render auto-deploy via GitHub webhook ✓
- SHA parity (GitHub = Render) ✓

**The 3 critical ones are:**
1. **`IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY`** → fixes AI chat
2. **`IVX_OWNER_PASSWORD`** → fixes owner login (which also unlocks self-deploy, authenticated endpoints, etc.)
3. **Unpause Supabase** → fixes database, featured properties, JV deals, queue, and everything that depends on the DB

Once you set those 3, I can re-run the full audit and verify everything works end-to-end. Want me to check anything else while you set those up?
